update_plan: School staff enter new students, payments, invoices, enquiries, expenses and attendance through the portal/forms.
The dashboard reads the structured records and refreshes KPI cards, charts and action lists.
The bursar uses the debtors table to filter parents owing by class, priority or amount.
Management reviews fee collection, admissions, boarding and expenses weekly.
Growth/Premium clients can add login, staff roles, automatic daily refresh and reminder workflows.
